title: The Fall
description: Adam and Eve disobeyed God in the garden — and even in that moment, God promised a Rescuer would come.

waypoints.title: Trouble in the Garden
waypoints.body: God gave Adam and Eve one simple instruction: don't eat from one tree. A serpent twisted God's words, and they chose to disobey. Sin broke the perfect friendship between people and God — but God didn't leave them without hope.

waypoints.title: When You Know Better
waypoints.body: Talk about a time you knew something was wrong but did it anyway. How did it feel afterward? God still loved Adam and Eve after they disobeyed — how do you know he still loves you when you mess up?
